Gold before the jobs report: beyond the Fed's target range




Why it matters: Lower real Treasury yields would reduce one cost of holding gold: the inflation-adjusted return available from a competing asset.




Context: Currency moves or demand for safety could outweigh the real-yield channel. That would make a simple bond-yield explanation inadequate.
